name: Haus Beer
beschreibung:
Quietly and sunnily located on the edge of Ellmau, Haus Beer offers comfortably appointed apartments for families and couples looking to relax amidst alpine scenery.

The Hartkaiser cable car, the KaiserBad Ellmau pool complex, and hiking paths are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Beer in Ellmau features cosy holiday apartments with direct views of the Wilder Kaiser.
